material: Generated dataset demonstration recordings, observation.image camera stream
selection: Six illustrative tasks per category, episodes 0, 5 and 9 for every task. This is a curated subset, not an exhaustive dataset or policy evaluation.

processing.crop: A fixed 4:3 crop per task encloses the union of final ink bounds across all three episodes, with padding. Full temporal sequence retained; no mirroring, color changes, inserted strokes or synthesized motion.
processing.posters: Final observation frame from the same episode; only used before playback.
